_comment: An AI-generated song theme: a child's day from waking up to good night. Instrumental (works in every language), with everyday sounds and animals woven in. Generate with generate.py (see README.md). Lively and soft songs alternate; the last three wind down for bedtime. Songs with 'sections' are generated from a composition plan: each section is a chunk whose length comes from its bars and the song's bpm, so the song has a form (intro, A, B, A' a step higher, ending) and moving harmony instead of one repeated loop.
name: ✨ My Day ☀️
attribution: Music generated with [Eleven Music](https://elevenlabs.io/music) by ElevenLabs.

defaults.style: Instrumental only, no vocals, no singing. Modern children's TV and picture-book production: clean, warm, bright, not harsh, gentle dynamics suitable for toddlers. Clear memorable melody that repeats, simple chords. End with a clear, gentle ending, no fade into silence.

sections.cue: return to the home key C major; the main melody on glockenspiel and ukulele with everything together; a final rooster crow

sections.name: Ending
